_note: STARTER zones, 2026-09-28: rough rectangles drawn by hand to get the terrain model working. Replace with real zone data. Rings are [lat, lon]; props per docs/MAP-FORMAT.md section 7. Terrain only decides at tile (200 m) granularity. The plant-* zones were converted mechanically from src/city/sf/parks.ts (2026-09-28), first-match-wins becoming priority; plant-city is the old CITY_PARK/LAWN/WOOD default. ggp-* meadow zones and plant-sausalito added by hand the same day: rough rectangles, to be corrected.

zones.name: Hyde Street Pier's deck, level at sea + 2.5 m
zones.note: 2026-10-18: the pier's paths had sunk 2-3 m under the sea (pier walks take the land's level, and the land at its foot is the flattened sea bed). OSM way/456528981.

zones.name: Pier 39's deck, level at sea + 0.4 m
zones.note: 2026-10-17: the elevation tiles smeared the pier down toward the sea bed — 6 m under the carousel plaza north of z 110, 1 m round Buildings B-D (the Pier 39 subagent's survey). The boardwalk ring from regions.json pavedSquares, north of the entrance pavers (the land end rises to the Embarcadero for real).

zones.name: 5th Street Plaza, Mission Bay: paths open to bikes
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-17: 'this little square has no way to bike through 37.773446, -122.395180' (OSM way/46274019, place=square; its paths are paving-stone footways).

zones.name: California College of the Arts campus passage: paths open to bikes
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-17: 'very interesting alleyway with no bike path 37.769095, -122.398847' (CCA's passage between 8th and Hooper: footways and bicycle=dismount service ways).

zones.name: Embarcadero Plaza and Harry Bridges Plaza: paths open to bikes
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-17: 'right now its hard to get to embarcadero downtown from the street grid because there are few paths across the plaza. we should make more of these bikeable'. East of the Embarcadero Center podium (its raised walks stay foot-only).

zones.name: Lands End and Sutro Heights
zones.note: relief raw (owner, 2026-10-06: the terrain smoothing flattens the cliffs): the bake's 60 m opening held the clifftop above Lands End dead flat for 70 m and spread the drop into an even 37 deg ramp (measured).

zones.name: Marin Headlands
zones.note: 2026-10-06 owner: low traffic (it was 'full of cars'), and the old army posts' white walls and red roofs (Fort Cronkhite, Fort Barry).

zones.name: ggp-west
zones._note: 2026-10-25: a real tropical-and-temperate mix (owner: "we didn't actually have any tropical plants … it looks like a cold weather park. The reality is it has an interesting mix of tropical and deciduous trees"): palms, tree ferns, cabbage trees, pohutukawa and bottlebrush raised to about a third of the lawns and a quarter of the woods east of the windbreak, and a tropical understory (bird of paradise, NZ flax, calla lily, agapanthus, fuchsia, Pride of Madeira).

zones.name: Sausalito (no street tree register)
zones.note: 2026-10-06 owner: 'a LOT more plants and gardens, with the open space': garden trees over the lawns and open ground, shrubs and flowers thick.

zones.name: The Presidio (its buildings)
zones.note: The park's real outline (OSM, from the package's park areas, simplified to 6 m), for what is BUILT in it: the Army's and the Park's own buildings, white stucco with red tile, never city rowhouses (owner, 2026-10-02; src/city/sf/btype.ts).

zones.name: Golden Gate Park (its buildings)
zones.note: The park's real outline (OSM, from the package's park areas, simplified to 6 m), for what is BUILT in it: the Army's and the Park's own buildings, white stucco with red tile, never city rowhouses (owner, 2026-10-02; src/city/sf/btype.ts).

zones.name: Alcatraz
zones.note: Appearance audit 2026-10-02 (BUGS.md #257): on the coarse grid the island topped out 11 m above the sea; it rises about 41 m to the cellhouse. 2026-10-04: cliffs — the island meets the bay in rock all round (views audit).

zones.name: Strawberry Hill (Stow Lake's island)
zones.note: Golden Gate Park audit 2026-10-04: the 60 m opening took the summit off — a flat mesa 14 m over the lake at 101.7 m, where the zoom-15 data (bare earth here) reads 130.4 m. The ring is the island's own shore (the hole in Stow Lake) pushed 5% out into the water; water samples are never raw, so the lake keeps its level and no ridden way crosses the edge.

zones.name: Yerba Buena and Treasure Island
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'There's WAY too much traffic; it's a mostly pedestrian area' (BUGS.md #254).

zones.name: Sausalito
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'a destination … little car traffic … many low stucco Spanish colonial buildings, not big boxy buildings'. 2026-10-06 owner: light traffic only.

zones.name: Tiburon and Belvedere
zones.note: 2026-10-05 (museum census): the Tiburon peninsula and Belvedere were drawn as San Francisco flats, Victorians and tenements (691 of 1015 buildings sfapartment). Marin's small-town houses instead (src/city/sf/btype.ts). East edge at -122.4495 below 37.8745 keeps Angel Island (its own presidio zone) out.

zones.name: Fort Point
zones.note: The surf breaking on the seawall under the bridge (owner, 2026-10-02).

zones.name: Sutro Baths, Cliff House and Point Lobos
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'i'm not seeing those unique buildings' — a forest stood over the baths, the Cliff House and the Camera Obscura. The real headland is bare cliff and scrub, cypress in ones and twos.

zones.name: Avenue of the Palms, Treasure Island
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'avenue of the palms should have...palms'.

zones.name: Sutro Forest
zones.note: Appearance pass 2026-10-02: Mount Sutro rose bare under the tower; the real hill is the Sutro Forest, tall blue gum eucalyptus all round it.

zones.name: Treasure Island
zones.note: Owner, 2026-10-02: 'Treasure Island … need a lot of work'. The Navy's island: low stucco quarters and new mid-rise blocks, never the city's brick, Victorians or tenements. Landmarks (Building 1, the hangars) are models.

zones.name: Embarcadero Center podium
zones._note: 2026-10-03: the podium level's walks (src/city/sf/bridges.ts EMBARCADERO_PODIUM_DECKS) are mostly footways; open them to bikes so the promenade, the skybridges and Maritime Plaza are one rideable route (owner: 'walkable/bikeable … go either on the road beneath or on the aerial walkway'). 2026-10-03: extended north over Golden Gateway Center's 12-13 m podium, so its walks are rideable too (owner: 'the embarcadero decks are not navigable').

zones.name: Tree Fern Dell
zones._note: 2026-10-03: the dell of tree ferns below the Conservatory of Flowers (John McLaren's fern dell), by eye from the park map — refine from OSM if it is mapped.

zones.name: Seward Mini Park
zones._note: 2026-10-03 (owner: 'the park is heavily wooded'): thick planting either side of the slides; the slides and their path are a clearing (seward-slides.ts grounds). Ring from OSM way/138662530.

zones.name: Twin Peaks (the summits and Christmas Tree Point)
zones.note: Viewpoints audit 2026-10-04: the summits are bare grass and coastal scrub, not the hills' park planting (eucalyptus, oak, blossom) — trees stood on the lawn at the top and in the view.

zones.name: Corona Heights (the rocky summit)
zones.note: Viewpoints audit 2026-10-04: the summit is a bare red-chert outcrop and grass; the park's trees are on its lower slopes by the Randall Museum.

zones.name: Tank Hill (the summit)
zones.note: Viewpoints audit 2026-10-04: a small bare rock summit with the view; eucalyptus round its foot.

zones.name: marin-headlands
zones.note: 2026-10-04 (views audit): the Marin Headlands are open coastal scrub with wind-bent cypress and a few eucalyptus groves; under the city's default mix they grew pink blossom and street trees. Rough rectangle south of Sausalito's own zone. 2026-10-06 owner (photograph): very few trees, dry hills under low coastal scrub, a few cypresses in the valleys; eucalyptus and oak out, densities cut, scrub thicker.

zones.name: alcatraz
zones.note: 2026-10-04 (audit): Alcatraz's planting is wind-blown eucalyptus and cypress over the ruins' gardens, not the city's park mix (palms, blossom).

zones.name: Presidio Tunnel Tops
zones.note: The Tunnel Tops (2022) are planted beds — bark mulch and low native shrubs between tan gravel paths, the oval lawns OSM maps the only grass (Commons 'Presidio Tunnel Tops aerial (cropped).jpg'; the owner's reference list, 2026-10-04). Ring: OSM way/91114607, the park's own outline.

zones.name: Yerba Buena Island light station cliff
zones.note: The lighthouse stands ~20 m up a sandstone cliff (owner's photograph, 2026-10-04); the coarse ground put it 2 m above the water. Fine raw relief over the station's shore, as Alcatraz (#257).

zones.name: Strawberry Hill's wood
zones.note: Strawberry Hill is a closed wood of eucalyptus, pine and cypress to the summit; at the park's density and clumping its raised flanks came out bare brown duff with trees only on the crest (audit 44, 2026-10-04).

zones.name: Angel Island (its buildings)
zones.note: Angel Island is an old Army post (Camp Reynolds, Fort McDowell, the Immigration Station) and a state park: its 94 buildings came out as Victorians and walk-ups (54 victorian, 27 sfapartment). The Army's white with red roofs, as the Presidio (2026-10-05).

zones.name: Fort Baker (its buildings)
zones.note: Fort Baker's parade ground (Cavallo Point): white Colonial Revival quarters and barracks under red roofs (Commons 'Fort Baker, Cavallo Point.jpg', 2026-10-05); were walk-ups and stucco boxes.

zones.name: Fort Barry (its buildings)
zones.note: Fort Barry in the Marin Headlands (the Headlands Center for the Arts, the hostel): the Army's white buildings with red roofs, as Fort Baker (2026-10-05).

zones.name: crissy-field
zones.note: Crissy Field (Marina audit 2026-10-05): the restored airfield is open meadow, dunes and tidal marsh, with a few windbreak cypress at the edges; the presidio-forest zone (100) was planting it as woods along the Golden Gate Promenade. Mason Street to the shore, the Marina's west edge to the West Bluff.

zones.name: Point Bonita
zones.note: Point Bonita's narrow rock ridge out to the lighthouse stood UNDER the sea on the coarse ground (-86.7 m against the sea at -84.5; manifest sheet audit 2026-10-05): the Marin Headlands zone stops at 37.82, 400 m north. Fine raw relief and cliffs over the point, as Yerba Buena's light station.

zones.name: The Presidio's ocean cliffs, Marshall's Beach
zones.note: Pacific swell on the rocks from Baker Beach to Fort Point (owner, 2026-10-06: the same surf on 'much of the shoreline').

zones.name: The Marin shore of the Golden Gate
zones.note: The strait's north shore, Kirby Cove to Lime Point, where the swell runs in on the rocks (owner, 2026-10-06).

zones.name: Angel Island State Park
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-06: 'Angel also should have no cars, it's all a park'.

zones.name: Broadway Tunnel west approach and the Hyde Street bridge
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-14: 'a somewhat broken underpass' at 37.796299 -122.418596. Broadway's centre roadway runs down a walled trench to the tunnel, Hyde crosses it on a short bridge, the one-way frontage roads stay at street level beside it. The zoom-15 ground smeared the trench across the banks (~4 m low), so Hyde and every street meeting it were raised as ramps on decks and roofed the junction. The lidar ground has the trench as it is.

zones.name: Fisherman's Wharf crowds
zones.note: owner, 2026-10-17: 'so many people' — the Wharf's sidewalks, Pier 39 and the courts are thick with visitors

zones.name: Francisco Park
zones.note: Francisco Park (2022, the old Francisco Reservoir, Russian Hill): terraced slopes of mounded grey-green and olive coastal scrub (coyote brush, buckwheat, sagebrush, ceanothus, toyon, monkeyflower, yellow leucadendron) and succulents (agave, aloe, aeonium, echeveria, a few cacti) in red bark mulch, flax, deer grass and big silver artemisia along the paths (owner, 2026-10-21: 'mostly succulents and shrubs'), under big Monterey cypresses and coast live oaks; the fenced lawn the only grass (owner, 2026-10-21: 'should be lush with plants', two Street View photos of Oct 2023). Planted beds over the OSM park (outline traced from the bake), its lawns left mown.

zones.name: Francisco Park dog run
zones.note: The fenced lawn along Bay Street at the foot of the park, under the boardwalk: the dog run (owner, 2026-10-21: 'the front is a grass dog park', with a Street View photo). OSM maps no grass here, only on the steep upper slope; the ring is the park's low north strip, sampled flat in the terrain (z 1262-1302 local).

zones.name: Francisco Park upper slope
zones.note: The steep slope down from Chestnut Street that OSM maps as grass is native scrub in red mulch, the path along its top lined with it (owner's Street View photographs, 2026-10-21). Its mapped lawn becomes part of the planted beds.
